This afternoon' s meeting is closed to the public pursuant to the Brown Act.

Regular City Council Meetings are scheduled on the 1st and 3rd Mondays of every month at 6: 30 pm.

1.  CALL TO ORDER

2.  ROLL CALL:  Council Member Lau, Council Member Crosby, Council Member Davis, Mayor
  Pro Tem Carder and Mayor Hepburn.

3.  CLOSED SESSION

  The City Council will meet in a closed session pursuant to Government Code Section 54957 for the
  following:

  Public Employee Performance Evaluation - City Manager.

4.  ADJOURNMENT

  THENEXT REGULAR MEETING of the La Verne City Council is
  scheduled for Monday, September 21, 2020 at6: 30p. m.

  The La Verne City Council thanks the community
  for taking all the precautions to prevent the spread of COVID- 19.

  Posting Statement: On September 10, 2020, a true and correct copy of this Agenda was posted on the bulletin
